one_line_description.value: Ahrefs provides an SEO and marketing data platform whose REST API and developer tools expose marketing and search data for custom integrations and workflows.
one_line_description.quote: Access Ahrefs marketing and search data through our APIs and developer tools to build custom integrations and workflows.

has_public_api.quote: With Ahrefs API, you can use data from your Ahrefs workspace to create custom integrations and automations.

api_breadth.value: REST API v3 covering 9+ product areas (Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, SERP Overview, Rank Tracker, Site Audit, Brand Radar, Social Media Management, Content Helper, Batch Analysis); mostly read endpoints plus limited read-write for Rank Tracker projects and Keywords Explorer lists; full OpenAPI spec published.
api_breadth.quote: API v3 allows you to pull data from the Site Explorer, Keywords Explorer, SERP Overview, Rank Tracker, Site Audit, Brand Radar, Social Media Management and Content Helper endpoints, as well as manage your Rank Tracker projects and Keywords Explorer lists:

auth_methods.quote: To send requests to Ahrefs API, you'll need an API key. Only workspace owners and admins can create and manage API keys.

access_model.quote: Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans. On all other plans, you'll still have access to a limited set of free test queries.

access_notes.value: API access requires an eligible paid plan; per the pricing comparison API access starts at Lite ($129/mo) and the Starter tier shows 0 API units. Free test queries exist but still require an API key. API keys are self-serve for workspace owners/admins in Account settings. Multi-user OAuth via Ahrefs Connect is a separate integration program: apps must be publicly available with an existing user base, and admission is at Ahrefs' sole discretion with a security/approval review.
access_notes.quote: Ahrefs API is available on eligible paid plans. On all other plans, you'll still have access to a limited set of free test queries.

rate_limits.value: 60 requests per minute by default; exceeding returns HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests); additional dynamic throttling can also return HTTP 429; unit consumption floors at 50 API units per request.
rate_limits.quote: Ahrefs API is limited to 60 requests per minute by default. If this limit is exceeded, the API will respond with an HTTP 429 status code (`Too Many Requests`).

sandbox_or_test_env.quote: Users on any paid plan can test Ahrefs API by running a limited set of free test queries. Note that you still need to create an API key to run free test queries.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: API is versioned as v3 (base URL pattern https://api.ahrefs.com/v3/...). No formal public deprecation schedule was found; Ahrefs Connect terms commit to commercially reasonable efforts of at least 30 days' notice for material reductions in functionality and at least 30 days' notice for planned program discontinuation.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: For material reductions in functionality, we'll use commercially reasonable efforts to give at least 30 days' notice; for planned program discontinuation, at least 30 days' notice.

verdict_reason: Ahrefs has broad, well-documented public REST API v3 with API keys and OAuth 2.0/PKCE, plus a vendor-hosted MCP server. However, credentials require an eligible paid plan (API access from Lite at $129/mo; Starter has 0 API units), so there is no free self-serve developer tier. Multi-user OAuth integrations additionally go through the Ahrefs Connect approval program.
main_blocker: Paid Ahrefs plan required (API access from Lite, $129/mo); multi-user OAuth needs Ahrefs Connect approval
